title: Slovakian Yellow Squash Skillet
description: A hearty, vegetarian skillet dish featuring roasted Slovakian yellow squash and glazed onions, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is easy to prepare and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the glazed onions and cook until caramelized.
Add the Slovakian yellow squash and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetarian kabanos sausage and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
